name: Komoro (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Komoro city emblem in white: an outlined five-petalled flower enclosing a disc with curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Komoro, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1954.

features.role: Komoro city emblem — an outlined five-petalled flower enclosing a disc with curved strokes
